A '''reanimated hellhound''' can be spawned by casting the [[Arceuus spellbook|spell]] [[Expert Reanimation]] on an [[ensouled hellhound head]]. Reanimation can be cast on any ensouled head within an 31x31 area where that head was dropped by a monster. This will work indefinitely, even if the ensouled head is picked up, so long as it is not put into the [[bank]], [[trade]] screen, [[Grand Exchange]], or [[price checker]]. If the player has done one of these things, they will no longer be able to reanimate the creature in the area where it was killed, but can still reanimate it within range of the [[Dark Altar]]. Killing the creature will grant the player 1,200 [[Prayer]] [[experience]].

Killing a reanimated hellhound will count towards a [[Hellhound]] [[slayer task]].
